Two stride-2 transposed convolutions restore the input resolution. The
probability map is a sigmoid over one channel.

`coordinate_transform_mode=2` and `round_mode=2` are the MAX names for
the nearest-neighbor mode the exported graph uses. RepLKPAN calls this
with factors 2, 4, and 8.

*Two stride-2 transposes. The probability map is a sigmoid over one
channel.*

The 3×3 reduces the fused neck to 64 channels. Each transpose doubles
the spatial size. The second one emits the single-channel probability
map.
